name: Honolulu
seo_title: Honolulu Christmas Events for Kids 2026: 23 Events, 8 Free
seo_desc: Christmas events for kids in Honolulu for 2026: Waikiki Holiday Parade, Santa at Ala Moana Center and Pearl Harbor Aviation Museum, and City Lights. 8 of 23 are free.
intro_html:
Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Honolulu for 2026, and here is what he found: 23 family events, 8 of them free. The magic runs from November 20 (Photos with Santa and Holiday Hula Shows at Ala Moana Center) through December 30 (Waikiki Trolley Holiday Lights Tour to Honolulu City Lights), with the Waikiki Holiday Parade (November 27), PHAMily Fun Day: Santa at the Hangar at Pearl Harbor Aviation Museum (November 28) and Santa's Secret Workshop at Hawaii Children's Discovery Center (December 12) along the way. We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.

What Rally found in Honolulu

  • 23 Christmas events for kids in Honolulu
  • 8 free events, including the Waikiki Holiday Parade, the Kaimuki Christmas Parade and Tree Lighting, Honolulu City Lights and Santa Claus Story Time at Honolulu Public Libraries
  • Meet Santa: Ala Moana Center, Kahala Mall, Pearl Harbor Aviation Museum (November 28), Santa Surfing on a Canoe at Outrigger Waikiki Beach Resort (December 5), Battleship Missouri Memorial (December 12 and 19) and Santa's Secret Workshop at Hawaii Children's Discovery Center (December 12)
  • Parades and lights: Waikiki Holiday Parade (November 27), Kaimuki Christmas Parade and Tree Lighting (December 3), Honolulu City Lights and the Waikiki Trolley Holiday Lights Tour
  • Shows: The Nutcracker at Blaisdell, The Nutcracker by Sacred Hearts Academy at Hawaii Theatre (December 12) and Elf in Concert with the Hawaii Symphony Orchestra (December 19 and 20)
  • Trains: no heritage train in town; the Waikiki Trolley Holiday Lights Tour and the Holly Jolly Waikiki Trolley are the holiday rides
  • Season: November 20 to December 30
